spec.title: URL Shortener
spec.description: A request's journey from the gateway to the response, then one tab per piece of infrastructure.

spec.expr:
# One band per k6 run, while it streams metrics.
max by (testid) (k6_vus{namespace="$Environment"})

# A new image in the pod spec that wasn't there one step earlier.
label_replace(
  count by (image_spec) (kube_pod_container_info{exported_namespace="$Environment", container="api"})
    unless count by (image_spec) (kube_pod_container_info{exported_namespace="$Environment", container="api"} offset $__interval),
  "version", "$1", "image_spec", ".*:(.+)"
)

# Container restarts. Skips a pod's first 5 minutes (its rollout),
# OOM kills (their own marker), and nodes that just rebooted (theirs too).
(
increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{exported_namespace="$Environment"}[$__interval]) > 0
  unless on (exported_namespace, exported_pod)
  (time() - kube_pod_created{exported_namespace="$Environment"} < 300)
)
  unless on (exported_namespace, exported_pod)
  (kube_pod_info{exported_namespace="$Environment"} and on (host_ip)
    label_replace(max by (instance) (node_boot_time_seconds) > time() - 600, "host_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*"))
  unless on (exported_namespace, exported_pod, container)
  kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"} == 1

# Container restarts whose last termination was an OOM kill.
(
increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{exported_namespace="$Environment"}[$__interval]) > 0
  unless on (exported_namespace, exported_pod)
  (time() - kube_pod_created{exported_namespace="$Environment"} < 300)
)
  and on (exported_namespace, exported_pod, container)
  kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"} == 1

# A node's boot time is newer than any it had in the half hour before.
# A window, not one step back: a node down for a while has no sample there.
max by (node) (node_boot_time_seconds)
  > max by (node) (max_over_time(node_boot_time_seconds[30m] offset $__interval))

spec.name: Gateway
spec.label: gateway
spec.description: The Gateway in front of the chosen environment. Derived, so hidden.

options.content:
**A request's journey**, from the gateway to the response. Read top to bottom.

SLO: **p99 < 500 ms** and **< 1% errors**, measured at the gateway.

spec.title: Requests/s
spec.description: Average over the selected time range.

spec.title: Success
spec.description: Share of requests that did not get a 5xx. Target: 99% or more.

spec.title: p99 latency
spec.description: 99% of requests were faster than this. Target: under 500 ms.

spec.title: Error budget burn
spec.description: How fast bad requests (5xx or over 500 ms) use the 1% budget. 1 = exactly on budget. Above 1 = too fast.

spec.title: Requests by status
spec.description: Responses the gateway returned for the API. 3xx is a successful redirect.

spec.title: Latency vs target
spec.description: Latency at the gateway. The dashed line is the 500 ms target.

spec.title: Average time per request, by hop
spec.description: Where an average request spent its time. Stacked, so the top is the total. Averages, because percentiles can't be added.

spec.expr: clamp_min((sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="api", route=~"(GET|POST) /v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="api", route=~"(GET|POST) /v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) - ((sum(rate(redis_query_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="api"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(redis_pool_acquire_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="api"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="api", route=~"(GET|POST) /v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) - (sum(rate(pg_pool_acquire_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="api"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="api", route=~"(GET|POST) /v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) - (sum(rate(pg_query_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="api"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="api", route=~"(GET|POST) /v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))), 0)

spec.title: p99 per hop
spec.description: The slowest 1% at each hop. Log scale.

spec.title: Client vs gateway p99 (load tests)
spec.description: Only during k6 runs. The gap is the network (Tailscale) and the client.

spec.title: Host
spec.description: Worst node: share of time work waited for CPU (PSI). See the Host tab.

spec.title: Gateway
spec.description: Worst average time a request spent in the gateway, outside the API. See the Gateway tab.

spec.title: API
spec.description: Highest average in-flight requests, as a share of the limit. See the API tab.

spec.expr: max(sum by (pod) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="api", route=~"(GET|POST) /v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / on (pod) max by (pod) (http_in_flight_limit{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="api"})) * 100

spec.title: Postgres
spec.description: Worst p99 wait for a database connection. See the Postgres tab.

spec.title: Redis
spec.description: Worst p99 wait for a Redis slot. See the Redis tab.

spec.title: Cache hit ratio
spec.description: Lowest share of reads found in Redis. Misses go to Postgres.

options.content:
**The Proxmox host.** All 8 VMs share its 6 cores (12 threads).

When it is full, every stage slows at once.

spec.title: Host CPU in use, by pool
spec.description: vCPUs busy across all VMs. The dashed line is the host's 12 threads.

spec.title: CPU steal, by node
spec.description: Time a VM wanted CPU but the host gave it to another VM.

spec.title: CPU pressure, by node
spec.description: Share of time work waited for a CPU (PSI). Rises before CPU hits 100%.

spec.title: Kernel network work, system nodes
spec.description: CPU the kernel spends moving packets (softirq) and in syscalls (system). The gateway runs here.

spec.expr: sum by (node, mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{node=~"system-.*", mode=~"softirq|system"}[$__rate_interval])) / on (node) group_left () count by (node) (node_cpu_seconds_total{node=~"system-.*", mode="idle"}) * 100

spec.title: Memory and I/O pressure, by node
spec.description: Share of time work waited for memory or disk (PSI).

spec.title: Postgres disk: busy
spec.description: Share of time the data disk on Postgres' node was busy.

spec.expr: max by (node) (rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{device="vdb"}[$__rate_interval])) * 100 and on (node) label_replace(max by (instance) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$Environment", pod=~".+-db-[0-9]+", container="postgres"}), "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")

spec.title: Postgres disk: latency
spec.description: Average time per read and write on that disk.

spec.expr: max by (node) (rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{device="vdb"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{device="vdb"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (node) label_replace(max by (instance) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$Environment", pod=~".+-db-[0-9]+", container="postgres"}), "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")

max by (node) (rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{device="vdb"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{device="vdb"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (node) label_replace(max by (instance) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$Environment", pod=~".+-db-[0-9]+", container="postgres"}), "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")

options.content: **Envoy**, on the system nodes. Traffic to the API only, unless a panel says *whole gateway*.

spec.title: Gateway vs API time
spec.description: Time at the gateway includes the API's. The gap is the gateway: queueing, network, Envoy.

spec.title: Requests in Envoy
spec.description: Average requests in flight to the API, from Envoy's time histogram. Queued: share of requests that waited for a free connection first.

spec.title: Rejected or failed
spec.description: Requests Envoy dropped: queue full, timed out, or connection lost mid-request.

spec.title: Open connections
spec.description: Clients: to Envoy, whole gateway. API: from Envoy to the API.

spec.title: TLS handshakes
spec.description: New TLS connections per second, whole gateway. Each costs CPU. Spikes when clients connect.

spec.title: Envoy CPU
spec.description: CPU per Envoy pod. The dashed line is its request.

options.content: **The Go service.** Top: is it keeping up. Below: why not (CPU, memory, code).

spec.title: Requests by route
spec.description: Requests per second, per route.

spec.title: Errors by route
spec.description: 5xx and 499 (client gave up) per second.

spec.expr: sum by (route, status) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="api", route=~"(GET|POST) /v1/.*", status=~"5..|499"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: p99 latency by route
spec.description: Time inside the API, per route.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="api", route=~"(GET|POST) /v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Latency distribution
spec.description: All API requests, by duration. Darker = more requests.

spec.title: In flight vs limit
spec.description: Average requests being handled. Past the dashed limit, the API answers 503.

spec.title: 503s by cause
spec.description: Why requests were turned away.

spec.title: CPU vs limit
spec.description: CPU per API pod. The dashed line is its limit.

spec.title: CPU starved
spec.description: Throttled: paused for hitting the limit. Waiting: ready to run, no CPU free (PSI).

spec.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="$Environment", container="api"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="$Environment", container="api"}[$__rate_interval])) * 100

spec.title: Scheduler wait
spec.description: p99 time a goroutine waits for a thread. Rising = not enough CPU.

spec.title: GC share of CPU
spec.description: Share of the API's CPU budget (GOMAXPROCS) spent on garbage collection.

spec.title: Memory vs limits
spec.description: Memory in use. Near the Go limit, GC runs more. At the container limit, the pod is killed.

spec.title: CPU by function
spec.description: Where the API spends CPU. Wider = more.

spec.title: Allocations by function
spec.description: Where the API allocates memory. More allocations = more GC.

options.content: **Postgres.** Client side: the API's connection pool. Server side: Postgres itself (CNPG).

spec.title: Pool in use
spec.description: Average share of the pool's connections checked out.

spec.title: Acquires that had to wait
spec.description: Share of requests for a connection that found none free.

spec.title: Wait for a connection
spec.description: p99 wait for a free connection. At the dashed timeout, the request fails with 503.

spec.title: Query latency
spec.description: p99 per query, from the API. The dashed line is the query timeout.

spec.title: Failed queries and acquires
spec.description: Anything but success, per second. not_found is normal and left out.

spec.title: Transactions and inserts
spec.description: Work Postgres does, per second.

spec.title: Buffer cache hit ratio
spec.description: Share of reads served from memory. Below the dashed 99%, reads go to disk.

spec.expr: sum(rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace="$Environment", pod=~".+-db-[0-9]+", job="kubernetes-pods", datname="app"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace="$Environment", pod=~".+-db-[0-9]+", job="kubernetes-pods", datname="app"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_read{namespace="$Environment", pod=~".+-db-[0-9]+", job="kubernetes-pods", datname="app"}[$__rate_interval]))) * 100

spec.title: Data size vs memory
spec.description: Database size against shared_buffers. Once data outgrows memory, more reads hit disk.

spec.title: Connections: open vs busy
spec.description: Open: the API's pool. Busy: average running a query. The dashed line is max_connections.

spec.title: Deadlocks and long transactions
spec.description: Deadlocks, and the oldest open transaction.

spec.title: WAL and checkpoints
spec.description: WAL written per second, and checkpoints forced by WAL volume.

spec.title: Postgres CPU
spec.description: CPU used. The dashed line is its limit.

spec.title: Postgres memory
spec.description: Memory used. The dashed line is its limit.

spec.title: Disk time
spec.description: Milliseconds per second Postgres spent reading and writing data files. 1000 = one session on disk full time.

options.content:
**Redis.** Client side: the API's slot pool. Server side: Redis itself (exporter).

Keys have no TTL, so memory only grows.

spec.title: Slots in use
spec.description: Average share of the API's Redis slots busy.

spec.title: Wait for a slot
spec.description: p99 wait for a free slot. The dashed line is the timeout.

spec.title: Command latency (from the API)
spec.description: p99 per command, measured by the API.

spec.title: Failed commands
spec.description: Timeouts and errors per second. Reads still fall back to Postgres.

spec.title: Cache hit ratio
spec.description: Share of reads found in Redis. Misses go to Postgres.

spec.title: Memory vs maxmemory
spec.description: Memory used. At the dashed maxmemory, Redis evicts keys or rejects writes.

spec.title: Keys and evictions
spec.description: Keys stored, and keys evicted per second.

spec.title: Command latency (in Redis)
spec.description: p99 inside Redis, per command. Excludes the network and the pool.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, cmd) (rate(redis_commands_latencies_usec_bucket{namespace="$Environment", grncunha_com_service="cache", cmd=~"get|set"}[$__rate_interval]))) / 1e6

spec.title: Redis CPU
spec.description: Redis runs commands on one thread, so 100% is full.

spec.title: Connected clients
spec.description: Open client connections.

spec.title: Did the client get a good answer?
Is the gateway slowing requests down?
Is it short of CPU or memory?
